title: Vintage Le Creuset oval baker / gratin dish size 32, made in France
description:
Beautiful matte bronze-brown enamel finish with a soft satin texture, characteristic of vintage 1970s–1980s Le Creuset ovenware. Elegant and timeless design, both decorative and practical for everyday cooking.
Ideal for gratins, lasagna, roasted vegetables or serving at the table. The warm earthy color and sculpted handles give this piece a very authentic vintage French kitchen look.
Stamped “Le Creuset – Made in France – 32” on the underside.
Good vintage condition with light traces of age and use visible on the edges, consistent with vintage cookware. Please refer to photos for details.
